thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate detected on /v1/embeddings for tenant=tenant-acme. 5xx spike -> routing shows requests mapped to variant 'gpt-chat-v1' instead of 'embed-quant-v2'. Paging on-call.
jamie_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing ~1.2k RPS failures from eu-west. Investigating routing map.
jamie_oncall: can someone check alias->variant mapping for tenant-acme? suspect a release pin.
ana_lookup (ana_sre): grabbing routing snapshot... `curl -s https://routing.internal/api/alias/tenant-acme` shows "pinned_variant":"gpt-chat-v1" — that looks wrong.
ravi_runtime: who pinned that? recent deploys show a pin change in release 2026-03-17T02:11:42Z, looks human-triggered.
luca_pm: we rolled a pin yesterday for a gen canary, but that was scoped. rough possibility: alias binding was reused.
jamie_oncall: paging runtime lead @ravi_runtime — can you remove the pin or set fallback to embed variant ASAP?
ravi_runtime: running emergency unpin now: `rw routing unpin --alias tenant-acme --reason "mis-pinned chat variant for embed traffic"`
devops-bot: command accepted, unpin job queued (job id: 0x9f2). Applying to eu-west-1 first.
ana_lookup (ana_sre): monitoring metrics... errors dropping. 5xx rate from 18% -> 1.2% within 30s :thumbsup:.
maya_custops: reached out to AcmeCorp support contact. They reported wrong-shaped embeddings and aborted indexing job. They've paused their pipeline.
jamie_oncall: quick question: were any embeddings persisted incorrectly or are failures transient? need storage check.
lucy_storage: quick scan of recent writes: only transient failures. No corrupted objects. Failed payloads archived to s3://incidents/3795600123/ for forensics.
ravi_runtime: adding a guard to control plane: pin validations must include interface match (embed vs gen/chat). I'll open a hotfix PR and gate the unpin/pin API.
luca_pm: action items: hotfix PR, rollback tests, customer comms. Assign owners please.
jamie_oncall: owners: ravi_runtime -> control plane hotfix + CR; lucy_storage -> preserve artifacts and confirm no data loss; maya_custops -> customer comms & status; ana_sre -> postmortem draft and timeline.
ana_lookup (ana_sre): creating incident timeline: root cause = incorrect variant pinned to tenant alias, causing embed requests to route to chat runtime which rejects payloads (schema mismatch) -> 5xx. Impact: AcmeCorp embeddings ingestion degraded for ~2 hours; other tenants unaffected.
maya_custops: sent interim message to AcmeCorp, apologized, shared mitigation steps and ETA for full postmortem.
ravi_runtime: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4821 (hotfix). Kicking off control plane rollout.
devops-bot: rollout complete to control plane (canary->global). Validation: alias mapping now rejects mismatched interface pin requests.
ana_lookup (ana_sre): verification: recovered traffic looks normal, no 5xx after routing fix for 10+ mins.
jamie_oncall: monitoring 2h watch then will close pager if stable.
maya_custops: will follow up with final customer note postmortem.
jamie_oncall: closing notes: stop-gap mitigation = emergency unpin; long-term = control plane validation + CI test for alias pin operations.
ana_lookup (ana_sre): postmortem owners assigned, timeline captured. Incident thread closed for now.
